evidenceGroup.qualification: macOS only; requires the installed 1Password desktop app and account, SDK integration enabled, explicit Blanc setup and authorization. Off by default; explicit matching Login fill only. No saving, payment-card fill, synced settings or provider passkeys. Demo uses a labelled fictional login after setup and authorization, reproducing the public v1.26.0 hint, native menu labels and fill capsule. It is an illustrative animation, not a live credential test or release screenshot.
